svg.desc: /develop:review — execution architecture — fans, joins and gates
svg.text: execution architecture — fans, joins and gates
↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card

g.text: codemap Gate A missing · B stale
an active plan names a changed module
no match → skip, noted in header
FAN 1–6 · one response · ranked units ‖ challenger ‖ Agent 0
git show PRE_REF, never the tree
JOIN · one <agent>.md per dimension · missing on notify → ⏱
more work → bigger briefs, not agents

svg.text: DIMENSION × CLASSIFICATION (WHO THE SPAWN PLAN PRESELECTS)
then ranked: top 3 units spawn unless --full · challenger and Agent 0 sit outside the cap

g.text: bare PR number → SETUP; (a) or no oss

svg.text: Shared pattern with /oss:review · ≤3 dimension units + challenger + Agent 0 + consolidator (+ ≤3 verifiers)
Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
